description: I started my career building interfaces in HTML and CSS. Over time, I moved beyond visual design into system thinking — understanding how UI components scale, how frontend architecture impacts teams, and how product decisions shape user experience.
My background across both design and frontend engineering allows me to see the full picture — from wireframes to production deployment.
I specialize in translating structured Figma systems into scalable, accessible React applications that teams can confidently build on.
